description:
Flavio Cadegiani, MD, PhD & Yusuf J.P. Saleeby, MD join Steve Kirsch for an FLCCC Educational Conference Recap.
They will provide the latest research on the impact of the COVID-19 vaccines and the treatment of Long Covid and vaccine injury.Show more Dr. Yusuf Saleeby is an Integrative & Functional Medicine doctor who recently joined the FLCCC Alliance, advocating for COVID-19 early treatments and developing vaccine injury protocols.
Dr. Flávio A. Cadegiani MD, MSc, PhD is an Endocrinologist & Visiting Professor, Faculty of Floriano (FAESF), Brazil
Founder, President & Medical Director – Corpometria Institute, Brazil
Ad hoc consultant for the Brazilian Health Regulatory Agency (Anvisa)
Consultant for Nat’l. Commission for Incorporation of New Technologies, Devices and Drugs, Brazilian Health System (SUS)
It will be a powerful night!
The VSRF’s mission is to advance COVID-19 vaccine safety through scientific research, public education, and advocacy, and to support the vaccine injured. https://www.vacsafety.org/
Join us for the VSRF Weekly Update
with Founder, Steve Kirsch & Executive Director, Louisa Clary
Every Thursday 7 PM EST / 4 PM PST
